comment: Independent C-first recording for options.c:optfn_hilite_status()'s do_set arm, reached from the full options menu's 'Set hilite_status to what?' prompt through parseoptions(). botl.c parse_status_hl1() accepts 'time/always/inverse' silently; with the time option on, the T: field changes on each of the two steps east, so the new rule shows on the status line.
